prompt: Having more money and less free time is better than earning less money and having more free time. Some people think that high salary is important when choosing a company to work for, while other think that good working atmosphere is more important, Discuss both views and state your opinion.
essay:
It is often debated whether people should prioritise higher compensation or a positive working environment when choosing a company. Although a healthy workplace can improve productivity and encourage employees to stay longer, I believe that a high salary is more important for maintaining a comfortable life and securing a decent future.

On the one hand, a positive working environment can enhance employees’ performance. When workers feel supported, trusted and comfortable, they are more likely to perform well and continue learning, which helps them develop their skills and abilities. Moreover, a healthy workplace can encourage individuals to remain with the same employer for longer, as they are less likely to feel stressed or consider resigning. For instance, many employees in the UK banking sector only work for their employers for a short period because of stressful and toxic environments, despite receiving relatively high wages. Therefore, a supportive atmosphere can contribute significantly to job satisfaction and employee retention.

On the other hand, I believe that higher pay is more important because it enables people to live comfortably outside the workplace. With inflation increasing the cost of everyday necessities, a well-paid job can help individuals and their families afford essential expenses, such as rent, groceries and their children’s education. It can also allow people to enjoy a better quality of life through leisure and travel, while providing greater financial security for retirement. For example, in Saudi Arabia, employees with higher salaries generally receive higher pension payments after retirement. Therefore, prioritising a financially rewarding position can provide benefits that extend well beyond an individual’s working life.

In conclusion, although a positive working environment can improve performance, professional development and employee retention, I believe that a high salary is more important because it provides financial stability and supports a comfortable lifestyle both during and after employment.
